description.value: Fine-tuning of OMat24-pretrained EquiformerV2 (eqV2-M) on MPtrj and subsampled Alexandria (sAlexandria) datasets. This OAM (OMat24 + MPtrj + sAlex) fine-tuning strategy produces the highest performing non-compliant models on Matbench Discovery, achieving F1 score of 0.917 and energy above hull MAE of 20 meV/atom.
